description: Single and two storey rear extension; external alterations including bay window to front elevation
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the ..........elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

The window(s) at first floor of the southern flank elevation of the proposed development shall be of purpose-made obscure glass,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

The PWMS should include, but may not be limited to;</p><p class="x_MsoNormal" aria-hidden="true" style="margin: 0cm; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(36, 36, 36);">&nbsp;</p><ol start="1" type="i" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; margin-top: 0cm;"><li class="x_MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif;">A toolbox talk covering the ecology of and legislation which protects species which may be present on site, to be delivered to construction personnel by the ECoW;</li><li class="x_MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif;">Timing details for the close inspection of the lifted tile feature by a licenced bat worker (the results of which must later be submitted to the council);</li><li class="x_MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif;">A plan showing areas of sensitivity and exclusion zones;</li><li class="x_MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif;">Details of where and how waste and/or construction materials will be stored;</li><li class="x_MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm; and</li><li class="x_MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif;">Procedures to be followed if a protected species is discovered.</li></ol><p class="x_MsoNormal" aria-hidden="true" style="margin: 0cm; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(36, 36, 36);">&nbsp;</p><p class="x_MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(36, 36, 36);">The approved PWMS shall be implemented in full according to the specified timescales, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.</p>

<p class="x_MsoNormal" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody" style="margin: 0cm; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(36, 36, 36);">No external lighting shall be installed on the extensions hereby permitted unless full details of a lighting scheme are submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall include details of the exact location, height, design, and intensity of the lights, and shall be designed to prevent light spillage onto nearby habitat suitable for bats. The lighting shall be installed and operated strictly in accordance with the approved details.</p><p class="x_MsoNormal" aria-hidden="true" style="margin: 0cm; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(36, 36, 36);">&nbsp;</p>

<p class="x_MsoNormal" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody" style="margin: 0cm; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(36, 36, 36);">Prior to the commencement of construction, a scale, colour plan of biodiversity enhancements on the site, to include the number, specification, and location of enhancements such as bat and bird boxes, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Thereafter, the biodiversity enhancement measures shall be carried out and retained in accordance with the approved details.</p><p class="x_MsoNormal" aria-hidden="true" style="margin: 0cm; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(36, 36, 36);">&nbsp;</p>
